summary: Frontend-only test of ActivityCard feedback, Pipedrive-style, on /persone/:id and /affari/:id. All requested flows pass: opening the panel via the title, 'Lascia un feedback' and the circle; Salva feedback with a yellow note while the activity stays planned; reopening from the note; Annulla restores the note; 'Salva e completa' moves the card to Cronologia with a green check and the note; editing the note in Cronologia; reopening from the check; Completa e richiama 1d/1w/4m with correct new dates; QuickReschedule regression with 3d; the activity form on the deal page still creates activities.

issues: A completed activity appears twice: as the history line 'Attività completata: X' and as the ActivityCard just below it. This is redundant. The deal Cronologia shows only the card.

action_items: Optional: in completeAndRecall, PATCH done and POST the new richiamo as two separate calls. If the POST fails, the activity is already completed and no recall is created. Consider a single backend endpoint, or a rollback on failure.
Optional: remove the duplicate 'Attività completata' history entry next to the activity card in the person Cronologia
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityCard.completeAndRecall is not atomic (PATCH, then POST). A partial failure leaves an inconsistent state.
The new richiamo does not copy 'ora' or 'priorita' from the original activity. This may be intended.
No pending or disabled state on the save, complete and recall buttons. A double-click can create duplicate richiamo activities.
